title: Update app domain to Cutiepie and republish

requirements.text: Update the project/app domain name to "Cutiepie" (letters only; 5–50 characters; no underscores) and rerun the publish/deployment so the site is published successfully under that domain.

quotes: change domain with Cutiepie and publish it.

acceptanceCriteria: The configured app domain is exactly "Cutiepie".
Domain validation passes (contains only letters, numbers, and hyphens; length 5–50).
A publish/deployment run completes successfully without domain validation errors.

constraints: Do not use underscores in the domain; domain must be 5–50 characters and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens.
Do not modify any immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: No UI/UX changes to the gift page content or styling.
No changes to backend canister APIs beyond what is required for publish to succeed.
